start: Profile tab, Reports, member with workouts this month and last month

user_sees: Title 'November 2026', subtitle 'Monthly report'
Big line like '12 workouts' with 'November so far'
Coach note, 'Days you trained · n' with a month grid, the records section
must_not: '0 kg' on a month of only runs
The 'Next' arrow active past this month

user_sees: Title 'October 2026'
'Against September' with three tiles: Workouts, Kg lifted, Sets, each with its change
must_not: Tiles of different heights or a number broken over two lines

steps.action: Tap the send icon 'Share as a picture'
user_sees: A share sheet with a picture of the month
must_not: A share button on a month with no workouts
The picture showing another month's numbers

start: Progress or Stats screen, year row

user_sees: Title '2026 so far', subtitle 'Year in review'
'Workouts each month' bar chart
must_not: The year shown as 'in review' before it is over

user_sees: Title '2025 in review' when the member trained in 2025
must_not: The arrow active when no workout exists before 2026

steps.action: Use the plain-text share row under the report (for an AI chat)
user_sees: The period as text, named 'November 2026' (or the year)
must_not: A share row on an empty period

start: Reports, a past month with no workouts

steps.action: Open a month with no logged workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts in October'
'Nothing was logged that month.'
No share button
must_not: An error, NaN or '0 workouts' hero card

steps.action: Open this month before any workout
user_sees: 'No workouts yet this month'
'Workouts you log this month will show here.'
must_not: The words of a finished month

steps.action: Open a broken link such as report/2026-13
user_sees: This month's report
must_not: A crash or a blank screen

steps.action: Open the report with the phone's data read failing
user_sees: 'Couldn't load this report' with 'Try again'
must_not: 'Go back and try again' with no button

steps.action: Tap 'Try again' after the read works
user_sees: The report loads
must_not: The old error left on screen

steps.action: Open the current month again after it has ended
user_sees: The full month title, and 'Against <month before>' now shows
must_not: 'so far' kept on a finished month

steps.action: Tap 'Share as a picture' and look at the picture before sending
user_sees: Only workout numbers, records and kg lifted of this member
must_not: Body weight, photos or notes on the picture
